---
name: Benchmark Needed
about: Request a CodyBench eval suite for a specific skill or behaviour
title: '[BENCH] '
labels: benchmark-needed
---

## Skill or Behaviour to Benchmark
Which skill/feature needs an eval? (e.g. cm-tdd regression catch rate)

## What to Measure
What outcome should improve with CodyMaster? (e.g. "percentage of regression bugs caught before merge")

## How to Score (0–100)
How would you define a 100 vs 0 score for this eval?

## Baseline (Without CodyMaster)
What happens today without CodyMaster? Describe the control condition.

## Related Suite
- [ ] This could extend an existing suite: `tdd-regression` / `token-efficiency` / `memory-retention` / other
- [ ] This needs a new suite in `codybench/suites/`
